crossRefs.note: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

translations.web: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.
translations.bsb: At the four corners of the bronze grate he cast four rings as holders for the poles.
translations.kjv: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
translations.asv: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grating of brass, to be places for the staves.
